title: 第493章 谁的身影
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
在裂缝时空战场之中，欧阳庄主召唤出阎罗铠、金圣罗等各种圣境级道则防御，由神威凝聚出来的防御罡气高达千丈。
裂缝时空都被欧阳庄主金色圣罗多笼罩，到处都是法则的威压，甚至连裂缝时空罡气都无法靠近欧阳庄主。
为了打破欧阳庄主金圣罗、阎罗铠防御，林雲释放出岩浆火焰气息，恐怖的岩浆火焰星辰爆从裂缝时空上方降落。
凝聚着岩浆火焰之力的星辰之力轰向欧阳庄主的金圣罗、阎罗铠之上，每一道火焰星辰都会给欧阳庄主沉重的打击。
“噗嗤！”欧阳庄主以法相金圣罗疯狂的抵挡着岩浆火焰星辰之力的冲击，每一次撞击都会让欧阳庄主发成沉闷的声响，连阎罗铠都被高温熔岩火焰给化为一滩圣水，更何况欧阳庄主的肉身。
欧阳庄主脸色沉重，疯狂的释放出圣境道则来维持金圣罗法相，即使欧阳庄主拼命的释放出神威，可是金圣罗法相在火焰星辰的轰击之下，法相神威之力越来越小，体型已经逼近破防的边缘。
“我看你还能够承受到几时！”林雲大喝道，岩浆火焰星辰源源不断的从裂缝时空中砸落，恐怖的威压席卷而来。
欧阳山庄之上，众人望着虚空中消失的两人，竟没有一人离开。林雲与欧阳庄主进入裂缝时空足足有半个时辰，虚空之上虽失去了两人的身影。可是狂暴的神威轰鸣却没有停止过。
恐怖的神威轰鸣不断从苍穹之上传出，谁也知道肯定是林雲与欧阳庄主两人正在激烈的战斗之中。
众人怎么也没想到林雲竟然能与欧阳庄主打到这个程度，一个圣境一重天的少年竟然能够对抗修行了千万年的欧阳庄主，若是众人亲眼所见，谁也不会相信这种事情。
上官玉儿眼睛紧闭，不停的祈祷。希望林雲能够平安无事，不过上官玉儿很快又为自己的幼稚行为感觉到可笑。
content_en:
In the cracked space-time battlefield, Master Ouyang summoned various holy-level Taoist defenses such as Yama Armor and Golden Saint Luo. The defensive aura condensed by divine power reached a height of thousands of feet.
The cracked time and space is shrouded by the golden Saint Luoduo of Villa Ouyang, and the pressure of the law is everywhere. Even the aura of the cracked time and space cannot get close to Villa Ouyang.
In order to break through the defenses of Ouyang Manor Master Jin Shengluo and Yama Luo Kai, Lin Yun released the magma flame breath, and the terrifying magma flame star explosion descended from the crack in time and space.
The power of the stars that condensed the power of magma and flames blasted towards Master Ouyang's Golden Saint Luo and Yama Luo armors. Each flaming star would deal a heavy blow to Master Ouyang.
"Pfft!" Master Ouyang used Dharma Golden Saint Luo to frantically resist the impact of the magma, flames and stars. Every impact made Master Ouyang make a dull sound. Even the Yama Armor was turned into a pool of holy water by the high-temperature lava flames, not to mention Master Ouyang's body.
Master Ouyang's face was heavy, and he frantically released the Holy Realm Dao to maintain the Golden Saint Luo Dharma. Even though Master Ouyang desperately released his divine power, under the bombardment of the flame stars, the power of the Golden Saint Luo Dharma's power was getting smaller and smaller, and his body size was approaching the edge of breaking through.
"Let's see how long you can endure it!" Lin Yun shouted, magma, flames and stars continuously fell from the cracks in the space and time, and the terrifying pressure swept over.
Above Ouyang Villa, everyone looked at the two people disappearing in the void, but no one left. Lin Yun and Master Ouyang entered the crack for half an hour, but their figures were missing in the void. But the violent roar of divine power never stopped.
Terrifying roars of divine power continued to be heard from the sky, and everyone knew that it must be Lin Yun and Master Ouyang who were in a fierce battle.
No one expected that Lin Yun would be able to fight Master Ouyang to such an extent. A young boy from the first level of the Saint Realm could actually fight against Master Ouyang, who had practiced for thousands of years. If everyone saw it with their own eyes, no one would believe such a thing.
Shangguan Yu'er closed her eyes tightly and kept praying. I hope Lin Yun will be safe and sound, but Shangguan Yu'er soon felt ridiculous for her childish behavior.
